title: Cottage w/ NEW Hot Tub 1.5 miles to Broadway
description:
The Ultimate Nashville Airbnb Experience in the Heart of Germantown! Surrounded by the Best Restaurants, this historic 3BR/3BA house is only 1.5 miles from Broadway!  Beyond charming home will be sparkling clean. Includes a hot tub, and 7 beds! Dining Room and living area, as well as, outdoor dining/bar make it Perfect for Indoor/Outdoor entertaining.  Perfect for any type of large group, the entertainment options are endless and the location and charm are second to none.

The space
Bed Count:
Bedroom 1 -  1 king bed
Bedroom 2 - 2 queen beds
Bedroom 3 - 2 queens beds
Bonus Room - bunk bed - top single/bottom full.
Indoor living room seats 7 comfortably
Dining room seats 10 comfortably, (two long benches at table)
Outdoor living
Seating for 10+ outside
New Hot Tub
Huge deck for entertaining

Guest access
All access, except one owners closet in hallway in back of house.

Other things to note
Fireplace in living room is decorative only. It is nonfunctioning. 

The bonus room does not have a door, so is technically not a bedroom, but because of its placement it is semi private.

Ice dispenser from fridge door only.

Disclaimer: For security and to maintain the integrity of the property and neighborhood, we have installed security cameras.  Cameras are on the outside of the house only.  Front and Rear entry.
